summary: Fixed: pending claim signature promotion wraps its cursor within the same call instead of returning zero at an empty tail while earlier signatures still wait.

replay.detail: Existing pending signatures are settled by the next promotion pass.

schema.detail: No schema or stored cursor format change.

rules.detail: Signature verification and membership admission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Wire formats are unchanged. Each promotion call still processes at most one bounded page; an empty tail now performs an additional indexed seek to the start.

manual.detail: No migration or manual repair required.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes to reverse.
